<div class="filter-chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by type">
  <button type="button" class="chip active" data-filter="all">All</button>
  <button type="button" class="chip" data-filter="interview">Interviews</button>
  <button type="button" class="chip" data-filter="op-ed">Op-eds</button>
  <button type="button" class="chip" data-filter="podcast radio">Podcasts &amp; radio</button>
  <button type="button" class="chip" data-filter="talk">Talks</button>

</div>

::: {#outreach}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.querySelector(".filter-chips").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const chip = e.target.closest(".chip");
  if (!chip) return;
  const f = chip.dataset.filter.split(" ");
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chips .chip").forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle("active", c === chip));
  document.querySelectorAll(".out-item").forEach((it) => {
    it.hidden = !f.includes("all") && !f.includes(it.dataset.type);
  });
  // Hide year headings with no visible entries
  document.querySelectorAll(".out-year").forEach((h) => {
    h.hidden = !document.querySelector(`.out-item[data-year="${h.dataset.year}"]:not([hidden])`);
  });
});
</script>
```
